claim: covers=fragment. A run with no exception establishes, by exact deterministic exhaustive verification (all 15 perfect matchings enumerated by recursion over the 6-vertex set; no floats, no I/O, fail-closed verify(witness) entrypoint that raises on any failed check), that the witness graph K_{2,2,2} minus a perfect matching has a nonadjacent pair (u,v) whose common neighborhood induces a K_22, while G is K_222-free. Hence L1 as stated is FALSE; its PROVED status must be revoked and route R001 cannot close branch B via L1.
law: Wang 7.2: an exact finite object plus a proved reduction is a CERTIFICATE. The reduction is the `claim` and is a human's to audit; the object and the verifier run are the machine's part.
